bar.$description: The desktop bar. See docs/decisions/0009-floating-bar.md, 0021-borderless-bar.md and 0022-bar-logo.md.

image-height.$description: Height of an image module, the font size of type.ui-small, so an image weighs about as much as the text beside it.

bar-style.$description: One group per bar style. Every style has the same properties, and the build writes one Waybar config, stylesheet and Hyprland theme per style.

floating.$description: A container inside the frame, with an outline and rounded corners. See docs/decisions/0009-floating-bar.md.

padding.$description: Inset on all sides, which keeps markers clear of the outline and the corners.

window-gap.$description: Hyprland's top gap, between the bar and the windows.

plain-padding.$description: Side padding of a module that never becomes a marker, the same as a marker's, so the first and last text sit about 8px from the outline.

workspace-width.$description: Smallest width of a workspace, padding included. One bar line, so the current workspace's marker is a square.

workspace-padding.$description: Side padding of a workspace, the marker padding, so the current one inverts without moving.

workspace-gap.$description: Space between workspaces. Markers side by side are space.marker apart (0012).

current-underline-width.$description: The floating bar marks the current workspace with a fill, not an underline.

borderless.$description: Text straight on the wallpaper, centred in the floating bar's height. See docs/decisions/0021-borderless-bar.md.

padding.$description: No outline, so no inset to keep markers clear of it.

margin-top.$description: The floating bar's outline width plus its padding, so the text sits as far from the top of the bar space as in the floating bar.

window-gap.$description: The same as margin-top, so the text is centred and the windows start the floating bar's height below the top of the screen.

plain-padding.$description: A module that never becomes a marker sits on the window edge.

workspace-width.$description: Workspaces are as wide as their digit, since none of them becomes a marker.

workspace-gap.$description: One cell, about one character, so the digits read as spaced text.

current-underline-width.$description: The current workspace is underlined with a hairline, as list matches are (0019), so the bar keeps one colour and no fills.
